approved: ACK 20 Nov 2026: option B of STALE_UNIVERSE_PRICES_root_cause_2026-11-20.md (one-time store backfill plus a governed daily writer for the board universe).
rationale: The price store's universe ETFs had no writer once Discovery's universe became stock-only (16 May 2026; RSP/UUP were never in it). This step writes the board universe's completed sessions into the store through HistoricalPriceDatabase.ingest, after the board's settle margin (board config prices.settle_minutes), from the grouped daily bars the board already caches (no extra call when cached). The daily step only inserts sessions the store lacks and never revises a stored value; a gap longer than max_daily_gap_sessions is left whole and reported for the one-time backfill (per-ticker adjusted history, dry run first, run by ACK). Splits: one Polygon splits call covers the window; a listed split re-fetches that ticker's full adjusted history (the old rows become recorded revisions). A day-on-day close ratio beyond jump_hold_ratio (either way) with no listed split is held, not written (19 Nov 2026: BITO x1.983 on the board's grouped bars, a likely reverse split; 3x ETFs rarely pass +45% or -31% in a session; the most common split ratios are 2 and above). seam_tolerance: a stored close and the re-fetched close count as the same when within 0.5% (as the 7 Oct backfill). PROVISIONAL: jump_hold_ratio and max_daily_gap_sessions are starting values, to be reviewed on the receipts.
